title: How quickly does steering efficacy decay over long generations?

original_idea.body: Generate long outputs with constant steering and measure target behavior as a function of token position, testing whether efficacy decays and whether re-anchoring the coefficient restores it.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: whether steering persists over long agentic generations targets a priority long-horizon threat.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Agentic long-horizon robustness on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Steering decay over long generations appears largely untested.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Position-dependent steering decay may be a fresh angle.
